svg.title: A mixture of two Gaussians and its E-step posterior
svg.desc: Left, the density of a mixture of a narrow Gaussian at minus 1.5 and a wide one at plus 1.5, each with weight one half, drawn as two dashed components and their solid sum. Right, the probability that a point came from the left component. With a shared variance it is a sigmoid in x, falling from one to zero. With the separate variances of the left panel it is near zero on both sides and peaks near the narrow component, because far from both means the wide component is the likelier source.
